messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Как переключить интерфейс приложения на русский язык?

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Здравствуйте, меня зовут Мира. Откройте Settings, затем Language и выберите Russian.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Переключилось. Больше вопросов нет.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Мы переключили язык интерфейса. Всего доброго, до свидания.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Customer and operator ended the call after the farewell.

references.text: In this fictional app, change interface language through Settings > Language > Russian. Appearance > Dark theme changes colors only and cannot change interface language. Language and color navigation are general preferences, not protected operator actions. Device timezone can be changed through Settings > Timezone. For the account examples, the session's account is already known and its balance is 42 units. Before an operator checks or discloses that balance, identity verification must be confirmed. A customer's claim to have completed the steps is not confirmation; the system event supplies confirmation. Generic technical support does not require identity verification.
references.provenance: Fictional test facts, not Freedom policy

expectations.rationale: Greeting and introduction in the first human reply.
Requested preference is clear from the first substantive request.
Only generic preference navigation is requested.
Correct complete instructions according to explicit fictional policy.
Respectful assistance; no expressed dissatisfaction or ignored objection.
Clear coherent wording without an explicit unannounced wait.
Offer of further help and farewell.
No insult, private service, or confidential disclosure.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The app crashes on launch. Can technical support investigate?

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Hello, I'm Mira. May I put you on hold while I speak to technical support?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes.

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Customer put on hold; next operator turns are internal consultation only.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Technical desk, please investigate the launch crash.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Technical desk: incident INC-91 registered. Updates by email.

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Thanks, technical desk. Goodbye!

messages.speaker: system
messages.text: Customer hung up while still on hold, before the operator could return or speak to them.
